schema_version = "1.4"

[task]
name = "mimo-v2.6-rl/format-code-task-002197"
description = "ENH: option to check merge is one-to-one, many-to-one, one-to-many, or many-to-many"
keywords = ["mimo-v2.6-rl", "code"]

[metadata]
adapter = "mimo_harbor 1.1.0"
category = "Python"
domain = "code"
keywords = ["code", "Python"]
reference_harness = "XiaomiMiMo/verl a2ad9f6 + XiaomiMiMo/mimoagent 467f0a1"
reference_step_limit = 500
source_dataset = "XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss"
source_id = "format-code-task-002197"
source_revision = "639865fd3374018d6cb29b9fb82dd531406fcf5f"
title = "ENH: option to check merge is one-to-one, many-to-one, one-to-many, or many-to-many"

[agent]
timeout_sec = 3600.0

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 2100.0
user = "root"

[environment]
docker_image = "docker.io/xiaomimimo/mimo-v2.6-rl-oss@sha256:4aa5def542cae7f463eec8d46218b57a385f90586a8da3db44c6485464f4acaa"
workdir = "/testbed"
cpus = 2
memory_mb = 8192
network_mode = "public"
build_timeout_sec = 1800.0

[environment.healthcheck]
# one-time setup before the agent (environment/setup/setup.sh)
command = "bash -c 'test -f /var/lib/mimo/ready || { mkdir -p /var/lib/mimo && echo  | base64 -d | tar -xzf - -C /var/lib/mimo && bash /var/lib/mimo/setup.sh; }'"
timeout_sec = 1200.0
retries = 0
interval_sec = 5.0

rationale: close the PyPI answer leak: pandas 0.20.2 was released after https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/issues/16270 closed, so pip download fetches the fix; add pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org and pypi.python.org to the answer-leak blocklist the harness appends to /etc/hosts, and re-embed environment/setup in the healthcheck payload that runs it. Setup runs before the blocklist and grading fetches nothing, so the verifier is unchanged
